name: Comoros (1963–1975)
description: A green field with a white crescent in the upper hoist and four white five-pointed stars in a diagonal row from the lower hoist to the upper fly.
history: The first flag of the Comoros, designed by Suzanne Gauthier and adopted for local use in 1963 while the islands were still a French territory; the crescent stands for Islam and the four stars for the four islands. It remained in use after independence on 6 July 1975 until Ali Soilih's coup, and was replaced on 12 November 1975.
